verses.en: Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.
verses.pt: Que as pessoas nos considerem como servidores de Cristo, e guardiões dos mistérios de Deus.
verses.en_web: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants, and stewards of God’s mysteries.
verses.en_bbe: Let us be judged as servants of Christ, and as those who are responsible for the secret things of God.

verses.en: Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.
verses.pt: Além disso, exige-se dos guardiões que cada um seja fiel.
verses.en_web: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards, that they be found faithful.
verses.en_bbe: And it is right for such servants to be safe persons.

verses.en: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man’s judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.
verses.pt: Quanto a mim, pouco me importa ser julgado por vós, ou por qualquer juízo humano; nem eu julgo a mim mesmo.
verses.en_web: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by man’s judgment. Yes, I don’t judge my own self.
verses.en_bbe: But it is a small thing to me that I am judged by you or by man's judging; I am not even a judge of myself.

verses.en: For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is the Lord.
verses.pt: Porque em nada me sinto culpável; mas nem por isso estou justificado; porém quem me julga é o Senhor.
verses.en_web: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: For I am not conscious of any wrong in myself; but this does not make me clear, for it is the Lord who is my judge.

verses.en: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of God.
verses.pt: Então nada julgueis antes do tempo, até que o Senhor venha, o qual também trará à luz as coisas ocultas nas trevas, e manifestará as intenções dos corações; e então cada um receberá de Deus a aprovação.
verses.en_web: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason let there be no judging before the time, till the Lord comes, who will make clear the secret things of the dark, and the designs of the heart; and then will every man have his praise from God.

verses.en: And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.
verses.pt: E isto, irmãos, fiz a comparação relativa a mim e a Apolo por causa de vós; para que em nós aprendais a não fazer suposições além do que está escrito; para que não fiqueis arrogantes por preferir um contra o outro.
verses.en_web: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.
verses.en_bbe: My brothers, it is because of you that I have taken Apollos and myself as examples of these things, so that in us you might see that it is not wise to go farther than what is in the holy Writings, so that no one of you may be lifted up against his brother.

verses.en: For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?
verses.pt: Pois quem te faz diferentemente superior? E o que tens tu, que não tenhas recebido? E se o recebeste, por que te orgulhas, como se não o tivesse recebido?
verses.en_web: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?
verses.en_bbe: For who made you better than your brother? or what have you that has not been given to you? but if it has been given to you, what cause have you for pride, as if it had not been given to you?

verses.en: Now ye are full, now ye are rich, ye have reigned as kings without us: and I would to God ye did reign, that we also might reign with you.
verses.pt: Vós já estais satisfeitos, já estais ricos, e reinastes sem nós; e bom seria se vós reinásseis, para que também nós reinássemos convosco.
verses.en_web: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you.
verses.en_bbe: For even now you are full, even now you have wealth, you have been made kings without us: truly, I would be glad if you were kings, so that we might be kings with you.

verses.en: For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.
verses.pt: Pois acho que Deus colocou a nós, os apóstolos, por último, como sentenciados à morte; pois somos como espetáculo ao mundo, tanto aos anjos como aos seres humanos.
verses.en_web: For, I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.
verses.en_bbe: For it seems to me that God has put us the Apostles last of all, as men whose fate is death: for we are put on view to the world, and to angels, and to men.

verses.en: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.
verses.pt: Nós somos loucos por causa de Cristo, mas vós sábios em Cristo; nós fracos, mas vós fortes; vós ilustres, mas nós desonrados.
verses.en_web: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.
verses.en_bbe: We are made to seem foolish for Christ, but you are wise in Christ; we are feeble, but you are strong; you have glory, but we have shame.

verses.en: Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace;
verses.pt: Até esta presente hora sofremos fome e sede, e estamos nus, e somos golpeados, e não temos morada certa.
verses.en_web: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.
verses.en_bbe: Even to this hour we are without food, drink, and clothing, we are given blows and have no certain resting-place;

verses.en: And labour, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it:
verses.pt: E ficamos exaustos, trabalhando com as nossas próprias mãos; somos insultados, e bendizemos; somos perseguidos, e nós suportamos.
verses.en_web: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
verses.en_bbe: And with our hands we do the hardest work: when they give us curses we give blessings, when we undergo punishment we take it quietly;

verses.en: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.
verses.pt: Somos blasfemados, e respondemos humildemente; somos feitos como a escória do mundo, e como o lixo de todos, até agora.
verses.en_web: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
verses.en_bbe: When evil things are said about us we give gentle answers: we are made as the unclean things of the world, as that for which no one has any use, even till now.

verses.en: I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.
verses.pt: Não escrevo estas coisas para vos envergonhar; mas sim, para vos advertir como a meus amados filhos.
verses.en_web: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
verses.en_bbe: I am not saying these things to put you to shame, but so that, as my dear children, you may see what is right.

verses.en: For though ye have ten thousand instructers in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.
verses.pt: Porque ainda que tivésseis dez mil tutores em Cristo, contudo não tendes muitos pais. Porque eu vos gerei em Cristo Jesus por meio do Evangelho.
verses.en_web: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.
verses.en_bbe: For even if you had ten thousand teachers in Christ, you have not more than one father: for in Christ Jesus I have given birth to you through the good news.

verses.en: Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.
verses.pt: Portanto eu vos chamo para que sejais meus imitadores.
verses.en_web: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.
verses.en_bbe: So my desire is that you take me as your example.

verses.en: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.
verses.pt: Por isso eu vos enviei Timóteo, que é meu filho amado e fiel no Senhor; ele vos lembrará dos meus caminhos em Cristo, como por todos os lugares eu ensino em cada igreja.
verses.en_web: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause I have sent Timothy to you, who is my dear and true child in the Lord; he will make clear to you my ways in Christ, even as I am teaching everywhere in every church.

verses.en: Now some are puffed up, as though I would not come to you.
verses.pt: Mas alguns andam arrogantes, como se eu não fosse até vós.
verses.en_web: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
verses.en_bbe: Now some are full of pride, as if I was not coming to you.

verses.en: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will, and will know, not the speech of them which are puffed up, but the power.
verses.pt: Porém logo irei vos visitar, se o Senhor quiser; e então conhecerei, não as palavras dos que andam arrogantes, mas sim o poder deles.
verses.en_web: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.
verses.en_bbe: But I will come to you in a short time, if it is pleasing to the Lord, and I will take note, not of the word of those who are full of pride, but of the power.

verses.en: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.
verses.pt: Porque o Reino de Deus não consiste de palavras, mas sim de poder.
verses.en_web: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.
verses.en_bbe: For the kingdom of God is not in word but in power.

verses.en: What will ye? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and in the spirit of meekness?
verses.pt: Que quereis? Que eu venha até vós com a vara da disciplina, ou com amor e espírito de mansidão?
verses.en_web: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
verses.en_bbe: What is your desire? is my coming to be with punishment, or is it to be in love and a gentle spirit?
